dedupe_keys.name: nbem spanish national building energy model generator

description: NBEM is a Python pipeline from the University of Zaragoza's Built4Life Lab for generating a national building-energy representation of Spain. It combines INSPIRE cadastral geometry, alphanumeric cadastral information and publicly available Energy Performance Certificates. The repository documents main.py as the configurable workflow and supplies a requirements file for libraries such as pandas, GeoPandas and Polars. Coverage is national, with individual georeferenced buildings and linked certificate attributes; the README does not give one common observation year or spatial accuracy. Public source is free under MIT. A key limitation is that alphanumeric cadastral inputs must be obtained manually province by province, while only some other input retrieval is automated. Certificate coverage is incomplete, so the intended national building inventory must not be equated with measured energy performance for every building. The code supports building-stock characterisation and the preparation of demand and retrofit scenarios. It complements EnergyPlus (model-energyplus) with cadastral and certificate-based inputs. The describing paper is dated 2024 in its full citation, despite an inconsistent 2023 sentence in the README.
